game: Sidereal Confluence: Trading and Negotiation in the Elysian Quadrant
edition_scope: Original2017 ten-page SC_Rule Book_061017_Web5 and all nine original species, Faderan reverse and accepted original printed component text; contemporaneous direct2017 designer clarifications separately labeled.
verdict_reason: All material procedures and all nine species asymmetries agree with the inspected original sources. One minor printed card-name transcription error remains in the Kt fixed-pair setup instruction. No consequential source gap was found.

source_reference.location: upper pair in the left-hand card diagram; right card title
source_reference.inspection_zoom: Additional in-memory native crop of original pixels [112,1290,750,1440], displayed directly; no derived file written.

findings.finding: The summary calls the right partner Volutility Components; the original printed card is Polyutility Components. The pairing rule itself is correct.
findings.impact: Minor identification friction while matching the fixed starting pair to the physical card; no changed converter, phase, cost, ownership or scoring rule.
findings.recommended_fix: Replace Volutility Components with Polyutility Components at summary line201.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Edition, objective, resource and card anatomy, visible holdings, interchangeable and unlimited pieces
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Six-turn highest-score objective, ordinary point secrecy and nontradability, resource sizes/colors/shapes, printed trade-value guidance and entry/upgrade icon meanings agree. No requirement to reproduce every component quantity.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Complete setup and deck/track handling
original_sources: Caylion, Im’dril, Kjas, Kt, Unity and Faderan sheets
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Species selection and printed starting quantities; starred cards versus unshuffled library; initial colonies/research; era ordering; front-side-up tracks, minimum-to-maximum dealing, player-count choice, Kjas extra colony slot and initial two colonies; special-deck/component setup agree. Faderan worked example matches p3.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Ordinary turn and final turn counts/order
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Turns1–5 Trade/Economy/share/colony bid/research bid; turn6 final Trade, normal scoring-only Economy, final sharing, no bids or seventh Trade. Six Trades, five ordinary Economies plus final Economy, five bidding Confluences. Final bonuses2/1/0 at3–4/5–6/7+, Yengii0, match printed cards. Last theft independently supported by article26803262.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Trade permissions, binding promises and failed-agreement losses
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Resources/ships/cards/promises; consensus and multilateral/contingent agreements; future promises binding; agreed compensation or perform possible portion and lose2/card-octagon-point and1/cube-ship; negative scores; species loans versus permanent backgrounds; end-Trade condition and late Trade abilities agree.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Technology invention, complete alternative costs and immediate/delayed entry
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Control research team; pay one full displayed alternative; invention output immediately; flip research; inventor matching card immediately; sharing bonus and ordinary matching cards at Confluence; Yengii/eraIV exceptions agree.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Violet entry and upgrades; possession restriction and hidden spent cards
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Violet resource upgrades during Trade, entry icon exception to in-play requirement, alternative named-card spending with both cards in play and owner possession; one upgrade per spent card; renamed upgraded identity and hidden spent card unavailability agree. Restriction on both cards grammatically belongs to named-card route; resource-paid borrower upgrade follows ordinary violet converter control.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Colony support, ordinary-colony destinations and no deck reshuffle
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Current climate, flip costs, ordinary colony consumption to deck bottom front side up, deck discard order; support check at beginning of Economy, acquire excess before then; nullspace consumption exception agrees.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Economy inputs, optionality, no chaining and no negotiation
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: White economic converter normally optional once, free when input empty, complete preexisting goods; simultaneous outputs cannot become inputs (points and ships included); procedure and silent Economy agree.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Donation custody, gifting and final retention
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Donation area until next Trade disposal; no refused gifts, donation points tradable exception; producer keeps final donation goods; gift versus actual trade does not automatically protect from Zeth.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Sharing technologies and bonus selection
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Every preceding Trade invention announced, face-down central splay with names legible; current bonus per invention; upper-right Yengii; library entry; eraIV nonsharing; private Yengii license rules agree.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Bid commitment, purchases, passing and ties
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Announce ships; commit both hidden bids and retained pile; colonies then research; ranked opportunity, all committed ships spent on purchase, legal minimum, pass retains; fewer relevant cards then higher printed tiebreak; Kjas/Kt/Yengii exceptions retained.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Bid negotiation and cleanup
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Only current bid cards briefly negotiated; promises binding but actual trades wait; minimum1 leftovers beneath own decks, slide left, refill right unflipped front/research face up.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Turn end and scoring
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Loan return, Confluence-card advancement, last donations retained; actual input colors and correct output sizes; half-point each octagon, complete2-large and3-small-or-ships groups; all leftovers formula, reveal points and no final tiebreak; final Zeth theft before counting score.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Caylion: halved colony bids, seedlings and violet upgrade output
original_sources: species-sheet-01-front.png; Halved Colonization Bids, Seedling Tokens, Upgrading the Caylion Economy
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: No rounding, research unaffected, odd fractional ties; start/track seedling only; two simultaneous white uses, upgrade converter unaffected, remains through flip/trade, removed at discard; Trade yellow output immediately tradable.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Eni Et: interest and Unity wild handling
original_sources: species-sheet-02-front.png; Interest Converters, Unity Wild Resources
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Own interest converters forbidden including upgrades; one ordinary matching color, size/quantity printed; gray input survives unchanged, no new wilds, remainder one color matching nonwild input; all-wild choice and 1wild+1blue to1wild+3blue example follow printed rules.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Faderan: Acknowledgments, deck-back activation and relic ownership
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Non-Faderan nontransferability, one mandatory token per invention and pool point, repeat across multiple inventions; shuffled face-down relic deck, single once-per-turn Trade deck converter despite repeated backs; four white plus jungle diagram; loan/return default and printed entry/economy effects.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Faderan Automated Transport Network and Contextual Integrator Cache
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: ATN1entry point+top2colonies, +2support holder/loan and Im’dril exception; Cache entry count non-Faderan-held Acknowledgments rounded up per3, transfer does not change global effect; mandatory1cube invention reduction only while active with token, no octagon reduction, ordinary token return/Faderan point.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Faderan Paradise Converter, Star’s Ruin and Gift of Duruntai
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Paradise any-climate colony to2points during Trade at most once, ordinary deck destination/nullspace removal; Star’s Ruin2+current Sharing Bonus on entering and no replay on later trade; printed card resolves sheet’s Invention Bonus wording; Gift first trade per turn rewards trader and Faderan blue, subsequent trade no reward, Faderan-first all output and no return.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Faderan Grindstone, Relic Detector and Transmutive Decomposer
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Each has1entry point; Grindstone existing point paid to pool, cannot run at0/use same-Economy point; Detector explicitly untradable, any-climate colony+3green extra relic draw and separate deck activation possible same turn; Decomposer ship input cannot use simultaneous output. Ordinary economic quantities remain on components as scoped.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Im’dril: fleet support, discovery and no ordinary colony support
original_sources: species-sheet-04-front.png; Fleet Support, Fleets, No Colonies
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Match required symbols to supplied support; split/combine; loan enough fleets with requiring card; borrowed nonrequiring cards do not require fleets; Trade discovery enters and grants point, starred fleet starts; colonies bid/traded/consumed but otherwise discard before Economy, ATN exception.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Kjas: split bidding, setup and territory tiles
original_sources: species-sheet-05-front.png; Military Might, Expansionist, Territory Tiles
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Split decision at normal ranked opportunity, equal as possible, rerank two half bids, purchase/pass halves and full half payment, no resplit, update colony-count tie between halves; counts twice only colony track, starts2; three tiles treated as cards, enter/flip violet top/bottom, loans and both depicted economic converters.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Kt: paired cards, nullspace, unlimited support and bid priority
original_sources: species-sheet-06-front.png; diagram and Nonlinear Thinking, Nullspace Drive, Boundless Expansion, Dangerously Fast
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Three depicted fixed pairs, no split/rearrange, independent upgrades, loan pair and return; nullspace Trade entry only, permanent trade, removal on world consumption; unlimited colony support, always colony-count tie priority, research only final infinity tiebreak after equal research-team counts. The first pair partner is printed POLYUTILITY COMPONENTS, not Volutility Components (finding01).

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Unity: flexible output/input, wild immunity and colonization
original_sources: species-sheet-07-front.png; Flexible Output, Flexible Input, Flexible Colonization, Computer Worlds
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Large wild black/blue/yellow and small green/white/brown; size fixed, independent colors, remain wild, immune to Zeth; Eni Et preservation/no multiplication; any same-size input cubes; any-climate colony entry/upgrades, four computer worlds out of play, one ordinary colony support and timing.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Yengii: private inventions and licenses
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Others cannot play matching cards absent license; normal benefit from others; keep invented tech in own splay, upper-right sharing bonus and invented cards excluded from research ties; same-Trade license permanently enters recipient matching card, cannot resurrect spent card.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Zeth: Envoys, theft and protection
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Envoys factory output bundled to one player with token, gifts cannot be refused, stash tokens trade-only and recipient cannot pass/backtrade; red phase after Confluence each turn incl final; one printed alternative input, one target/converter, shortfall steals possible, no double targeting, size/shape not color, envoy discounts nonconsuming, wild immunity; accepted actual trades protect, gifts/donations gifted do not, donation trades declared and Zeth can refuse.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Designer FAQ attribution and scope
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Raw author IDs1220373 link to TauCetiDD/TauCeti Deichmann with designer25517, matching booklet. Complete original dates and direct-body content support final Economy, input-color requirement, retained donations, sharing before no bids, all-leftovers formula, final theft and actual Zeth input colors. Other-user posts/quotes not treated as independent authority. Optional house rule permitting no final theft excluded.

checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.topic: Compact player reference consistency
checked_claims_and_procedural_passages.notes: Reference is consistent with detailed procedures; final-turn exclusions are explicit in Turn Structure and FAQ.

isolation_statement: I was newly assigned only this pure-source audit and authored no summary repairs. I read only the designated summary-snapshot.md and source-manifest.json, their actual listed original authorities, necessary original-source provenance, and the explicitly permitted species provenance. I did not read questions, keys, maps, reader answers, grades, prior audits/findings, specialist timing/addendum reports, repair history, root proof, or other QA reports. I did not communicate with readers or obtain their answers. Metadata was used for immutable lineage/authorship only; labels and embedded prior inspection comments were not treated as rules verdicts. Other users and quoted fan material present in allowed raw thread containers were excluded as independent authority. No module scripts or encoded module behavior, Remastered2020, expansions, optional precise scoring/timed trade/handicap, or optional no-final-theft rule were used. I did not edit the summary, stamp verification, or edit shared source files. Writes were limited to this source-audit.json and the ten authorized native PDF renders within source-audit-01.
